name: week.kill
description: Weekly kill review: given one list item -- routine, card or project -- and its evidence, should it be kept, paused, archived or stopped. The gate never kills anything; it separates 'still earning its place' from 'put it on Mike's cut list'.

value_evidence.instructions: Evidence this item produced value in the last 30 days, from the row
criteria: No runs and no output in 30 days
Defined or scheduled, but never actually run or produced anything
Ran, but the output was empty, vacuous, or read by nobody
Produced output that one named consumer uses
Produced recurring output tied to a workstream or a client deliverable
Produced output that moved a named number or shipped a named thing in the last 30 days

recent_run.instructions: The item has actually run or produced output in the last 14 days -- being defined, scheduled, or 'active' in a list is not running.

kill_candidate.instructions: On this evidence the item should be stopped, paused, or archived rather than kept.

evidence_complete.instructions: The row names the evidence needed to decide: when it last ran, what it produced, and who reads the output.

decision.instructions: What should happen to this item this week

criteria.keep: Keep running: it earns its place this week
criteria.pause: Pause it: reversible, and it stops consuming attention now
criteria.archive: Archive it: it is finished or superseded
criteria.stop: Stop it permanently: it should not come back

rules.reason: stopping work is Mike's call -- recommend it, never delete it
archiving is an estate change -- Mike approves it
kill candidate -- bundle it into the cut list for Mike
has not actually run -- define-only items are not work
evidence incomplete -- last run, output and consumer are all required to decide

notes.shape: A healthy item passes clean (keep). A dead item escalates as a kill candidate. The gate never performs the kill -- week kills are Mike's cut list.
notes.thresholds: Provisional and uncalibrated; BLOCK rules would report ESCALATE until calibrated (law 3). This pack carries no BLOCK rule on purpose. evidence_complete fires at <= 0.80, not 0.90: fixture runs on 2026-09-28 showed the classifier emitting 0.87-0.90 for rows that name last run, output and consumer all three, so 0.90 flagged healthy rows on noise.
